title: Numeric GitHub App and installation ids in a JSON document
summary: A JSON document with numeric app, installation and account ids and no token field.
rationale: The ids sit next to installation tokens in API payloads and are digits only; they are public-data controls that must not be taken for part of a token.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. The numbers are identifiers, not credentials. A project decision, pending a maintainer and a reviewer who is not the author; the provider pages read do not classify these ids.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
